{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment changes, showing lag instead of immediate alignment",
    "Sentiment turning negative (0.00 or below) requires cutting forecast prices faster than model suggests",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (0.67+), model-underforecasts the price decline needed to match true outcomes",
    "Mean reversion is evident in true outcomes but model doesn't fully capture the speed of price returning to historical ranges",
    "Sentiment exhaustion (repeated 0.67 or 0.00 values) indicates model needs more aggressive deviation from historical averages",
    "Model maintains prices too stable; true outcomes show more volatility especially when sentiment fluctuates rapidly",
    "When sentiment alternates frequently, model should more closely follow the most recent sentiment shift"
] }
